caption: Bagno Vignoni thermal square, Bagno Vignoni
composition: Steaming rectangular thermal pool filling the village piazza above Val d’Orcia · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The great rectangular thermal pool fills the center of the frame, its turquoise water steaming gently in the midday air, with the stone arcade of the old bathhouse running along the left and the village houses closing the right. Beyond, the rolling Tuscan hills of the Val d'Orcia stretch to the horizon under a clear 12:16 sky. The rising vapor off the warm water is the scene's quiet signature.
